title: Lulu third-party usage and cost coverage

options.content:
| Service | Observed usage | Cost / remaining balance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat + memory + voice writer models | Provider-reported tokens, including cache | Pi pricing **estimate**, not invoice; zero means free **or missing pricing** |
| Remote MCP tools | Tool attempts and outcomes through Lulu MCP | Tool responses are not assumed to carry billing units; see account collection below |
| Typesafe | HTTP classification attempts and outcomes | **Unavailable**: provider billing units and balance |
| E2B / configured compatible backends | Lifecycle SDK operations and separate [sandbox occupancy](/d/lulu-sandbox-occupancy) | **Unavailable**: provider-confirmed lifetime, CPU/RAM usage, billable seconds and balance |
| Doubao voice | Connections, observed connection seconds, sent input PCM seconds and audio bytes | **Unavailable**: provider token/credit billing and balance |
| S3-compatible artifacts / R2 | Server operations plus configured shared-bucket requests and storage maxima | **Unavailable**: reconciled R2 bill and Lulu-only allocation. Bandwidth analytics exclude transfers below 100 KiB |
| Cloudflare | Separate [Cloudflare dashboard](/d/lulu-cloudflare) | **Unavailable**: reconciled bill, shared allowance allocation. Local unattended collection is enabled; check health and freshness below. |

**No combined actual-spend total is available.** Unobserved services are missing, not zero. Worker instrumentation and the matching collector configuration were deployed on November 12, 2026. Panels populate from new traffic; there is no historical backfill.

Account exporter: Tavily exposes credit usage/limits by key and account. Exa exposes key MTD USD cost and team balance through an enabled Team Management API and separate `EXA_SERVICE_KEY`. Account/team totals may include other workloads. Panels remain **Not observed** until configured and collected; no key or service credential is displayed.

panels.title: External operation attempts by provider and outcome
panels.description: SDK operations / MCP tool calls, not billable credits or SDK retry counts. Errors can still consume provider usage.

panels.title: Model estimated cost (USD)
panels.description: Includes voice writer after rollout. Estimates only; never add run costs.

panels.title: Model cost coverage: estimated vs unpriced/free
panels.description: Calls with zero pricing remain ambiguous; an estimated value does not establish billed cost.

panels.title: Doubao input audio seconds
panels.description: PCM sent to upstream at 16kHz, signed 16-bit mono. Not recognized speech or billed duration.

panels.title: Doubao observed connection seconds
panels.description: Flushed on traffic after 30 seconds and on close; abrupt process loss can omit the last segment. Not billed duration.

panels.title: Observed upload bytes
panels.description: Doubao input audio and successful server S3 PUT payloads only; excludes direct signed-URL transfers.

panels.title: Received voice audio bytes
panels.description: Counts all upstream audio deltas, including discarded playback; not billed output tokens.

options.content: Cloudflare and account collectors run locally every fifteen minutes using a read-only 1Password service account and a systemd encrypted credential. A stale/missing value is **not zero consumption**. Health panels cover the last 45 minutes; missing health requires investigation.

panels.title: Cloudflare exporter health (last 45 minutes)
panels.description: Missing means no recent health observation; see Cloudflare dashboard for dataset health and freshness.

targets.expr: last_over_time(lulu_account_tavily_credits[45m]) and on (account_provider, account_dataset, account_scope, account_field) (last_over_time(lulu_account_tavily_field_present[45m]) == 1) and on (account_provider, account_dataset) (last_over_time(lulu_account_collection_success[45m]) == 1) and on () (last_over_time(lulu_account_exporter_success[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: Exa key cost: calendar month to date
panels.description: Current configured API key only. Key rotation does not merge historical costs from previous keys. Missing billing access is Not observed.
